sentences.text: Aba/978/2024 on 7 October, 2024

Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
 Office Notes,

 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order

S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  ABA No.978 of 2024  Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Deepak Sharma, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. S.C. Dumka, AGA for the State.

Applicant seeks anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.612 of 2024,
under Sections 420, 427, 467, 468, 471, 504 & 506 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Jwalapur, District Haridwar.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
According to the FIR, the informant was given a power of attorney in his favour with regard to a property.
The same property, FIR states was transferred in favour of the applicant by co-accused, by forging the documents.
Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the applicant is a bonafide purchaser of the property.
She purchased it from one Naseem Ahmed.
The informant is not the owner of the property.
He would submit that no forgery has been done.
It is also submitted that, in fact, the informant has filed a civil suit against the applicant, in which he could not get any interim order.
Thereafter, FIR has been lodged.
Reference has been made to the sale deed, copy of plaint and other documents.
Issue notice to the respondent no.3.
Respondents may file objections.

Having considered the submissions, as an ad interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to her furnishing a personal bond with two sureties, each in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer ("AO").

In addition to it, the applicant shall also comply with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall co-operate with the investigation.

(ii) The applicant shall not approach any witness in any manner, whatsoever.
(iii) The applicant shall not leave the country without prior permission of the court concerned.
(iv) The applicant shall deposit her passport with the AO.
The passport may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
In case, the applicant does not have passport, she shall give an undertaking to that effect to the AO.
(v) The applicant shall also give an undertaking on (i), (ii) & (iii) above.
(Ravindra Maithani J.) 07.10.2024
